absolute_accessible.description: Is the simplified text easy to read and understand for a lay-person and do all (sub-)parts of the text make sense on their own (paragraphs, sentences)?
absolute_accessible.name: absolute_accessible

accessible_and_simple.description: Is the simplified text clearly easier to read and understandable to a non-expert, while still preserving the important meaning?
accessible_and_simple.name: accessible_and_simple

actors_preserved.description: Are ALL responsible actors and affected parties correctly identified (no actors removed, generalized, or changed)?
actors_preserved.name: actors_preserved

actors_with_context.description: Are ALL responsible actors and affected parties correctly identified (no actors removed, generalized, or changed, allowing for the addition of actors from the context)?
actors_with_context.name: actors_with_context

content_preserved.description: Does the simplified text preserve ALL important obligations, actions, and decisions from the original?
content_preserved.name: content_preserved

no_hallucination.description: Is the simplified text free of any new information, claims, or interpretations not present in the original?
no_hallucination.name: no_hallucination

no_meaning_change.description: Does the simplified text avoid changing the meaning, strength, or conditions of the original (e.g. 'must' vs 'should', removing exceptions)?
no_meaning_change.name: no_meaning_change
